section.content: The utility model discloses a kind of biological gene PCR gene amplification instruments,Including fuselage,The bottom of the fuselage is provided with pedestal,The inside of the pedestal has been bolted to connection water tank and first motor,The first motor is located at the side of water tank,And one end of first motor is rotatably connected to turntable by shaft,It is bolted to connection rack for test tube at the top of the turntable,Semiconductor chilling plate is installed on the outer wall of the rack for test tube,The utility model is provided with condensate draining,Cooling fin and semiconductor chilling plate,When heating and cooling rise,Moisture in air condenses,Condensed water condenses on the outer wall of semiconductor chilling plate,Condensed water flows to one end of cooling fin by condensate draining,Finally pool water droplet,And instill water tank,By on the one hand service life that the condensed water discharge of semiconductor refrigerating on piece is extended to semiconductor chilling plate,On the other hand ensure that electronic component is in more dry environment,Improve the stability used.

本实用新型公开了种生物基因用PCR基因扩增仪，包括机身，所述机身的底部设置有底座，所述底座的内部通过螺栓固定连接有水箱和第电机，所述第电机位于水箱的侧，且第电机的端通过转轴转动连接有转盘，所述转盘的顶部通过螺栓固定连接有试管架，所述试管架的外壁上安装有半导体制冷片，本实用新型设置了冷凝水槽、散热片和半导体制冷片，升降温升时，空气中的水分发生冷凝，冷凝水凝结在半导体制冷片的外壁上，冷凝水通过冷凝水槽流向散热片的端，最后汇聚成水滴，并滴入水箱，通过将半导体制冷片上的冷凝水排出方面延长半导体制冷片的寿命，另方面保证电子元件处于较为干燥的环境，提高使用的稳定性。

A kind of biological gene PCR gene amplification instrumentTechnical field

The utility model belongs to biological gene technical field, and in particular to a kind of biological gene PCR gene amplification instrument.

Background technology

PCR, abbreviation PCR, PCR, English Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) be external enzyme' s catalysis specific DNA fragment a kind of method, several steps are extended etc. by high-temperature denatured, process annealing and thermophilic Reaction composition a cycle, cycle carry out, and target DNA is enable to expand rapidly, have high specificity, high sensitivity, operation letter Just the features such as, time saving.

In the Chinese patent that the patent No. is CN201220362426.8, it is noted that PCR gene amplification instrument module splashproof machine Structure, in refrigeration work, a large amount of condensed water is conducted into radiator threaded hole or evaporation, significantly by the groove of module Extend the lifetime stability of refrigerating chip and whole uniformity, still, in condensed water in evaporation process, the steam of evaporation is still It is present in PCR gene amplification instrument, the internal electronic element for thus causing PCR gene amplification instrument is in moist environment In, it is on the one hand easy to cause electronic component and is damaged, reduce PCR gene amplification instrument service life, it is poor in temperature on the other hand to cause It is different, the amplification of sample is influenced, in addition, PCR gene amplification instrument is when in use, sample tube is in relatively fixed position, in this way The non-uniform temperature that invisible spectro sample is subject to has been resulted in, sample amplification efficiency is influenced.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of biological gene PCR gene amplification instruments, to solve existing PCR bases The problem of non-uniform temperature that gene-amplification instrument proof mechanism of water waterproof effect is undesirable and sample is subject to.

To achieve the above object, the utility model provides the following technical solutions：A kind of biological gene is expanded with pcr gene The bottom of instrument, including fuselage, the fuselage is provided with pedestal, and the inside of the pedestal has been bolted to connection water tank and One motor, the first motor is located at the side of water tank, and one end of first motor is rotatably connected to turntable by shaft, described It has been bolted to connection rack for test tube at the top of turntable, semiconductor chilling plate is installed on the outer wall of the rack for test tube, it is described Semiconductor refrigerating on piece is provided with cooling fin and condensate draining on the side outer wall far from rack for test tube, the cooling fin is located at condensation The lower section of sink.

Further, the top of the fuselage is rotatably connected to cover by hinge, passes through spiral shell on the outer wall of the cover Bolt is fixedly connected with handle, and rack for test tube upper cover is provided on the inner wall of cover.

Further, it is provided with sealing ring at the top of the fuselage, and is provided with control panel in the front surface of fuselage, institute It states and is provided with function button and display screen on the side outer wall far from fuselage on control panel, the function button is located at display screen Lower section, supply hub, power switch and heat dissipation grid are provided in the rear surface of the fuselage, the heat dissipation grid is located at electricity The side of source jack and power switch, the supply hub are located at the lower section of power switch.

As an improvement, be bolted to connection electric-controlled box on the side inner wall of the fuselage, the electric-controlled box it is interior Portion is equipped with KS02Y controllers and PT100 temperature sensors, and the KS02Y controllers are located at the upper of PT100 temperature sensors Side.

As an improvement, the side of the rack for test tube is provided with the second motor, one end of second motor is turned by shaft It is dynamic to be connected with impeller.

Further, heat emission hole is offered in the front surface of the pedestal.

As estimation, there is tank lid by threaded engagement connection on the side outer wall far from first motor on the water tank.

The utility model compared with prior art, has the advantages that：

(1) the utility model is provided with condensate draining, cooling fin and semiconductor chilling plate, when heating and cooling rise, in air Moisture condenses, and condensed water condenses on the outer wall of semiconductor chilling plate, and condensed water flows to cooling fin by condensate draining One end finally pools water droplet, and instills water tank, and tank lid is screwed out condensation water collection by water tank, and condensed water discharge passes through In on the one hand service life that the condensed water discharge of semiconductor refrigerating on piece is extended to semiconductor chilling plate, on the other hand ensure pcr gene Electronic component in amplification instrument is in more dry environment, improves the stability used.

(2) the utility model is provided with semiconductor chilling plate, first motor and turntable, by by multiple semiconductor refrigeratings Piece is fitted in the surrounding of test tube, ensures that invisible spectro sample is in advantageously at a temperature of amplification, improves amplified reaction effect Rate can allow invisible spectro sample to generate a little centrifugal force in addition, driving the slow rotation of turntable by first motor, into And make it is invisible spectro uniformly in suitable for amplification at a temperature of.
